description: Enforcement-doctrine gate 2 (pre-write half): the orchestrator (main thread) must NOT edit/write source code inline — it plans, dispatches, verifies. A non-docs code Edit/Write WARNS first, then BLOCKS a repeat within the window, with 'delegate to a subagent'. Docs/config/lockfiles are exempt. SUBAGENTS are EXEMPT (CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION). Honest escape hatch: ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK=1 + ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK_REASON='why'. on_error=open.
